description: Understanding how a compiled, obfuscated, packed or virtualized target works: binaries and firmware, Android APKs and iOS IPAs, .NET and JVM assemblies, WASM and custom VMs, browser extensions, network protocols, stripped Go/Rust, anti-debug and anti-VM logic — plus turning a website's traffic into a typed API client. Use when the job is to read a target's behaviour before porting, patching or exploiting it.
